aggressive_definition_excerpt: Between 1995 and 2006, we ascertained 23,453 incident cases of prostate cancer, including 2,251 advanced cases and 428 fatal cases.
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: At baseline, dietary intake was assessed in a cohort of 293,464 US men in the National Institutes of Health (NIH)-AARP Diet and Health Study.
reason: Baseline diet was assessed before ascertainment of incident prostate cancer. The abstract analyzes total prostate cancer and the aggressive endpoints of advanced and fatal prostate cancer. It reports 2,251 advanced cases and 428 fatal cases; 2,251 is recorded as the aggressive case count because the fatal cases may overlap with advanced cases.
